notes:
Summary: Velaris is a regulated EU-headquartered fintech exploring Redwood Private (VPC) for customer-facing assistants and document search. Primary concerns are network isolation, data residency, auditability and BYOK.

Key asks / constraints:
- Must operate fully inside eu-west-1: embeddings, KV cache, logs — no cross-region replication. data_residency requirement is firm.
- Network: prefer AWS PrivateLink endpoints + Transit Gateway peering across accounts rather than public internet. Customer quote: "We cannot have any public endpoints for the data plane."
- Firewall & egress controls: Velaris requires static egress IPs to add to corporate firewall allowlist; only TLS to Redwood control plane over PrivateLink allowed. Explicit deny-all egress rule except approved endpoints.
- Ports/Protocols: TLS-only (443) for control plane/control-plane health. No inbound public ports. All management plane calls over PrivateLink.
- IP allowlists: need an RFC1918/assigned CIDR mapping for connector/agents + list of Redwood ephemeral IP ranges for peering.
- KMS/BYOK: Must support BYOK with HSM-backed keys. Velaris requests key-rotation policy, attestation, and sample IAM/KMS policy snippets. Legal wants clause for key destruction and escrow.
- Audit logging: request-level and control-plane audit trail exported to Velaris Splunk account; retention 12 months hot, 7 years cold. Syslog/CloudTrail integration required and demonstrable event ordering.

Security review status / asks from InfoSec:
- Security questionnaire submitted (drive link). Redwood asked to provide VPC network diagram, expected egress IPs, and PrivateLink ARN sample.
- SOC2 + ISO27001 copies requested; Redwood to confirm audit scope covers Private deployment model.
- Pen test: Velaris security ops wants to schedule a joint pen test window post-POC.

POC / performance targets:
- 2-week POC inside velaris dev VPC using PrivateLink endpoint.
- Latency target: 95th <= 150ms for chat flows (short context), throughput baseline 50 reqs/s for pilot.
- Measure: token-per-second cost baseline and KV cache hit-rate improvement.
